title: Unto the Economy
first_line: God planned His great purpose in eternity,

lines: God planned His great purpose in eternity,
This great will was hidden, a great mystery;
With wisdom and prudence He has made it known,
Through revelation, in Christ, the Son.
Unto the economy of the fullness of the times,
To head up all things in Christ,
The things in the heavens in Him;
Unto the economy of the fullness of the times,
To head up all things in Christ
And the things on the earth, in Him.
Through Christ’s incarnation God came into man,
And through crucifixion came redemption’s plan;
Then in resurrection, the Comforter came,
And in His ascension exalt His name!
It is God’s good pleasure to show us the Son,
And through His dispensing we are all made one;
Through this life abundant and rich life supply,
The church will be builded and beautified.
